note: Set A captures more distinct, correctly bound engineering facts — bolt length (4"), bolt diameter (3/8"), hex head type, CLEARVUE cable railing type, adjustable scaffold footing type, and the 8'-0" deck module dimension — that Set B omits or reduces to trivial 'presence' claims. Set B does pick up one fact A misses (7/16" plate holes @ 12" O.C.), but it repeats the joist, frame, grade level, railing-post-bracket and nail-spacing facts two or three times each and adds self-referential 'component = itself' claims. Both sets bind the 1'-4 3/4" and 8'-0" plan dimensions to a vague 'deck connection' entity; A additionally mis-attributes the 1'-4 3/4" dimension to Detail C1 (it is in A1, Typ. Deck Module), while B mis-states 8'-0" as deck-connection spacing. On balance A is the more faithful and more useful set.
remarks: Both sets ignore the whole A5 deck-to-house connection build-up shown in the text layer: 3/4" exterior plywood, 3" steel decking, W10 X 15, 4-1/2" structural insulated panel w/ vapor barrier, continuous waterproofing membrane, and 3" wood lag screw with washer — a significant shared omission. Set A also drops the 7/16" holes @ 12" O.C. spacing that B captures. The 1'-4 3/4" / 1'-4" / 1'-3 1/4" and 4'-0" / 8'-0" strings are plan dimensions of the typical deck module in detail A1, not 'deck connection' spacings; both extractors appear to bind bare dimension strings to whatever detail label is nearest. Text layer and image are legible; no administration content was used in judging.
